She explained that surgery and IVF were our best options for a successful pregnancy. Her clarity and guidance gave us the confidence to move forward.
She referred us to Dr. Jyotshna
Palgamkar at Nova IVF, Virar. Dr. Jyotshna Mam is such a soft-spoken, patient, and kind person. As we were completely new to IVF, she made us feel comfortable by explaining every detail of the treatment. Under her expert care, I conceived on my very first IVF attempt!
We are forever grateful to both Dr. Nilufer Moideen and Dr. Jyotshna for making our dream of parenthood come true. I highly recommend them to anyone struggling with fertility issues."
